answer: A bond must be split across 2 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each karst escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the violet ledger records every share and the oasis audit publishes the split. Assembling that for 85 aliases means 85 times 2 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
